fields.text: Drives the Pimoroni Fan SHIM's fan directly over GPIO18 using the gpiod command-line tools already installed on Raspberry Pi OS - no Python or fanshim package needed. Reads CPU temperature from /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp every few seconds.
Keep "Turn off at" comfortably below "Turn on at" - that gap (hysteresis) is what stops the fan rapidly clicking on and off right at one temperature.
